name: @maxiaochao/pi-herdr-subagents
description: Run inspectable interactive Pi subagent batches through Herdr.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types tests/config.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/core-state-machine.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/real-herdr-config.test.mjs
scripts.load-test: env -u PI_HERDR_SUBAGENTS_CHILD "${PI_TEST_BINARY:-pi}" -ne -ns --no-session -e ./tests/extension-contract.ts && env -u PI_HERDR_SUBAGENTS_CHILD "${PI_TEST_BINARY:-pi}" -ne -ns --no-session -e ./extensions/herdr-subagents.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tests/extension-sources-load.mjs
